decisions.reason: As a training offer that builds on the established service business and supports customer loyalty, it is likely to be retained because it fits the firm's public value proposition even though it requires less sunk investment than a machine platform.

This accessory is less visibly committed on the website and easier to discontinue, but because it extends the core milling ecosystem management is still inclined to persist unless demand is clearly weak.

Hybrid additive post-processing is relatively distant from the firm's established offer and was only lightly presented, so with weaker strategic fit and lower visible commitment it is the easiest product for management to abandon.

A high-speed CNC milling machine is close to the firm's core business, likely absorbed substantial development and commercialization resources, and was promoted prominently, all of which strongly favors continued commitment.

The automatic tool change system builds directly on the firm's installed base and efficiency narrative, and its dedicated presentation suggests enough investment and public commitment for management to continue backing it.
